summary: Backend-only smoke test of new /api/tests/extract-from-pdf changes. The endpoint is COMPLETELY BROKEN — every call returns 500 due to a NameError. Test blocked at first call; could not validate any of the 6 listed acceptance criteria.
passed: POST /api/auth/login with test@prepmind.ai/test123 returns valid JWT

failed.issue: NameError: name 'answer_key_text' is not defined. The variable is referenced at line 304 ('if answer_key_text:') and 311 but never assigned. The code that should fetch the optional answer-key PDF text (when req.answer_key_material_id is provided) and default answer_key_text to '' otherwise is entirely missing between the source-text fetch (~line 298) and the 'Build answer-source instructions' block (line 302).
failed.evidence: curl POST /api/tests/extract-from-pdf -> 'Internal Server Error'. Backend log: File '/app/backend/routes/tests.py', line 304, in extract_from_pdf  if answer_key_text:  NameError: name 'answer_key_text' is not defined

failed.issue: max_chars values do not match the spec. PRD/request says source text should use max_chars=80000 and answer-key text max_chars=40000, but code still uses max_chars=24000 for both get_material_full_text and get_material_pages_text. The increased-limit acceptance criterion (#5: ~30 MCQs across 5 pages) cannot be met.

Even after fixing the NameError, the answer_key PDF feature has no implementation path that loads the second material. The ExtractFromPdfReq.answer_key_material_id field exists but no code fetches that material or its text. The 'answer_key_block' will always be empty.
failed.evidence: No db.materials.find_one({'id': req.answer_key_material_id, ...}) or get_material_full_text(req.answer_key_material_id, ...) call exists in extract_from_pdf.

action_items: Add code in extract_from_pdf (between fetching source text and the 'Build answer-source instructions' block) to initialize answer_key_text='' and, when req.answer_key_material_id is provided, load the answer-key material (validate ownership + status=='ready') and call get_material_full_text(req.answer_key_material_id, max_chars=40000) to populate answer_key_text.
Bump max_chars in get_material_full_text / get_material_pages_text calls from 24000 to 80000 for the source text, per spec.
After the fix is applied, re-test the 3 extract scenarios listed in the review (no-key + fallback=false, no-key + fallback=true, separate answer-key PDF) plus the regression case.
